criteria.description: @spec-kitty/elements and @spec-kitty/react are publishable and appear in the derived set
criteria.evidence: `node scripts/release-graph.mjs --dirs` emits all four packages; re-adding `private: true` to either reds `check-release-graph.mjs` (probe: 'a package marked private with no EXPECTED_PRIVATE entry'). npm's own test is truthy, so `Boolean(pkg.private)` is used — `"private": "true"` as a string is also caught.
criteria.notes: Verified at de1ea2e. CI green on the head; every claim re-derived locally.

criteria.description: release.yml's build, publish and audit steps consume one derived list
criteria.evidence: `checkWorkflowUsesDerivedSet` requires steps.graph.outputs.* and rejects any run block naming >=2 packages, any per-package `working-directory`, and a step that also derives. `checkNoHandWrittenListsAnywhere` extends the floor to every workflow — three more lists were found by a lens and fixed.

criteria.description: The release path is exercised on every pull request
criteria.evidence: New unconditional `release-gate` job in ci-quality.yml, in `gate`'s strict list with no skipped-tolerance entry. `check-gate-wiring.mjs` REQUIRED_RELEASE asserts its payload; 16 disarm probes (if:, continue-on-error, needs removal, gutted payload, `|| echo`) all red.
criteria.notes: Verified at de1ea2e. CI green on the head; every claim re-derived locally.

criteria.description: Each tarball's contents are asserted, never its exit code
criteria.evidence: `npm pack --dry-run --json` per package; exports wildcards expanded with zero-match rejected; legacy main/types/module validated when exports is absent; a manifest-only tarball rejected. `npm publish` on a private package exits 0, which is why no check reads an exit code.
criteria.notes: Verified at de1ea2e. CI green on the head; every claim re-derived locally.

criteria.description: Every component's CSS is reachable by subpath
criteria.evidence: All 15 of packages/styles/src's component directories now have subpath exports, up from 3. `checkSubpathCoverage` compares export keys against directories on disk, because checkExportsResolve catches a broken export but not a missing one; removing any single entry reds the gate.
criteria.notes: Verified at de1ea2e. CI green on the head; every claim re-derived locally.

criteria.description: The gate refuses an empty set, proven by supplying one
criteria.evidence: `checkGraphFailsClosed` builds real fixture package trees (all-private, empty, no build target) and asserts the REAL accessors throw. Deleting both throws in release-graph.mjs reds the gate — verified. The earlier version passed synthetic stubs and could not fire.
criteria.notes: Verified at de1ea2e. CI green on the head; every claim re-derived locally.

criteria.description: A file:// load issues zero off-machine requests, asserted by interception
criteria.evidence: check-offline-load.mjs stages from real `npm pack` tarballs in a node_modules layout, intercepts requests AND websockets, waits a settle window, and asserts 14/14 elements upgraded with 30 @font-face rules resolving. --selftest plants an off-machine request and requires the probe to red on it.
criteria.notes: Verified at de1ea2e. CI green on the head; every claim re-derived locally.

criteria.description: ADR-5's release controls apply to every package in the derived set
criteria.evidence: audit, provenance, SBOM and contents audit all loop the derived list. The contents audit is now backed by check-release-graph.mjs ON THE RELEASE PATH — previously every assertion lived in ci-quality.yml, which a tag does not trigger.
criteria.notes: Verified at de1ea2e. CI green on the head; every claim re-derived locally.

criteria.description: Packed and unpacked size per package, recorded and regenerated
criteria.evidence: SIZES.md 'Published package sizes' table, from a real npm pack, with --check. Previously printed to a CI log only; a lens pointed out that a log line is not a record and that this repo's own convention is generate-and---check.

criteria.description: WITHDRAWN — mono font resolution is a brand decision (fork 2 on #80)
criteria.evidence: The dead @import is deleted (mechanical, no behaviour change: 32 rules / 0 imports before and after). The token still names a family that does not load; self-hosting vs dropping it is the operator's.
criteria.notes: Removed from spec.md's FR table rather than struck through, per the repo convention that a row is a requirement regardless of formatting.

negative_invariants: A release must never report success having published nothing: release-graph.mjs's output is captured into shell variables and asserted non-empty, because `echo "x=$(failing-cmd)"` exits 0 and `for pkg in ; do` iterates zero times.
A gate must never read an exit code where npm returns 0 for a no-op: `npm publish` on a private package warns and exits 0.
An exports wildcard matching zero files is a failure, not a pass.
A tarball containing only package.json/README/LICENSE ships nothing usable, even though npm always includes them.
A hand-written package list in any workflow is a second source of truth and is rejected.
The offline probe must red on a planted off-machine request, or its green means nothing.
